tools.name: verse_of_the_day
tools.description: Get the Bible verse of the day from Lamplight (https://lamplightverse.com), in the King James Version (KJV) or the World English Bible (WEB). Verses come from a fixed list of daily verses, one per calendar day, and the day turns over at midnight US Eastern. Pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) for yesterday, toda

tools.name: lookup_verse
tools.description: Look up a Bible verse, a range inside one chapter, or a whole chapter in the KJV or the World English Bible, from Lamplight (https://lamplightverse.com). At most 50 verses per call; split longer passages. References like "John 3:16", "1 Cor 13:4-7" and "Psalm 23" work. The text is the scripture stor

tools.name: todays_reflection
tools.description: Get the short reflection and one-line prayer Lamplight (https://lamplightverse.com) shows for a day’s verse, with the verse in the KJV (license: Public domain outside the United Kingdom). Reflections are written with help from AI tools and checked against each verse; the scripture itself is never AI

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_verse" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
